note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Extra keys (note, followup, manual_prepare, manual_teardown) are for the recorder person; the kit ignores them. DATAVERSE_URL must point at the Sales trial environment (trial ends about 21 Dec 2026). Every python command opens its own MSAL interactive sign-in (the token cache is in memory): the owner signs in as labadmin when the browser asks, or exports the app-registration variables in the shell before recording (never in a file).
prepare: if (-not $env:DATAVERSE_URL) { throw 'Set $env:DATAVERSE_URL to the lab environment URL in this shell first (the owner does this; it is never written in a file).' }
Push-Location src; python -m casekit doctor; Pop-Location
manual_prepare: Admin center: confirm Customer Service Hub is installed in the Sales trial environment (otherwise start the Customer Service trial: fallback in demo.md).
Give alex.demo Customer Service Representative and Customer service app access; sign in once to Customer Service Hub.
Copilot Service admin center as labadmin: SLA KPIs First response (FirstResponseByKPI) and Resolve (ResolveByKPI), SLA 'Contoso standard' (Enhanced), activate and Set As Default.
Account Contoso Retail must exist (episode 7 qualify, or create it).

screens.name: service-sla-config
steps: Select the Sales trial environment, Resources, Dynamics 365 apps: open the Copilot Service admin center
Service-level agreements: open 'Contoso standard' (Case, Enhanced) with its SLA items, active and set as default
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: casekit-triage
screens.note: Seeded cases are brand new: seed shows '=' lines when step 5 already ran, and triage finds nothing late until the High case passes its 4 h first-response target. Record what it prints and adjust the narration. Blur case ids.

screens.name: service-case-form
steps: Select the Sales trial environment, Apps, open Customer Service Hub (play)
Service, Cases, open '[MGL demo] Cannot sign in to the store portal' (High)
Show customer Contoso Retail and the SLA timers for first response and resolve
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: casekit-resolve
commands: python -m casekit resolve $env:MGL_CASE_ID --subject "Passwords reset" --description "Reset done, sign-in tested"
python -m casekit resolve $env:MGL_CASE_ID --subject "Passwords reset" --description "Reset done, sign-in tested" --apply
prepare: if (-not $env:MGL_CASE_ID) { throw 'Set $env:MGL_CASE_ID (GUID of the [MGL demo] case to resolve) in this shell first (owner; never written in a file).' }

steps: Customer Service Hub: the case is Resolved and the case resolution activity is on the timeline
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

manual_teardown: Delete the five [MGL demo] cases and their resolutions.
Unset the default SLA, deactivate and delete 'Contoso standard' and the two SLA KPIs.
Remove alex.demo's Customer Service roles if not needed; delete the fallback trial environment if one was started.
needs: trial:Dynamics 365 Sales trial environment (ends about 21 Dec 2026)
licence:Customer Service Hub access for alex.demo (fallback: Customer Service trial)
